era.title: Early Space Civilization
era.subtitle: The first permanent systems beyond Earth
era.description: This era marks the shift from isolated space missions to early off-world infrastructure, lunar industry, orbital services, Mars logistics, and the first institutions of space civilization.

seo.metaTitle: Era 2: Early Space Civilization | Future Civilization Roadmap
seo.metaDescription: Explore early space civilization milestones including lunar ice mining, orbital hotels, asteroid survey networks, Mars cargo logistics, lunar agriculture, and space law.

items.title: Lunar Ice Mining Begins
items.description: Water ice extraction begins near lunar polar regions, supplying oxygen, water, radiation shielding, and rocket propellant for sustained Moon operations.
items.civilizationImpact: Lunar logistics becomes less dependent on Earth launches, making permanent off-world activity more practical and economically viable.
signals: Polar prospecting missions confirm accessible ice deposits
Robotic mining systems operate through lunar night cycles
Propellant depots begin using locally processed water
implications: Foundation for fuel production beyond Earth
New governance questions around lunar resource rights
